rules.peak: Permanent maximum of actual account closing NAV; never reset after an exit or weak rebound.
rules.budget: floor=peak*(1-risk_drawdown); raw exposure=min(1,max(0,multiplier*(NAV-floor)/NAV)). Round down to 0.1 exposure steps. Reductions immediate at the close; increases require at least 0.2 raw budget headroom, except initial deployment. Decisions execute next open.
rules.ownership: Same independent shadow-model momentum ranking and persistent inventory, but cash deployment must respect the account risk budget. No global breadth veto, no symmetric volatility haircut and no full-risk reset after a loss.
rules.limitations: This is not a guaranteed 18% maximum drawdown: opening gaps, limits, missing quotes and execution capacity can cross the floor. A floor breach may leave the account in cash. Both failures must be retained and measured, not repaired by resetting the peak.

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / same_engine_buy_hold_wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20)); ties fewer fills then smaller candidate index
interpretation: New retrospective experiment, not a change to old acceptance thresholds. The 18% parameter controls the proposed policy, not a replacement economic acceptance definition. All earlier unsuccessful studies and all 24 new candidates are preserved.
